description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of different configurations in detecting misinformation. The horizontal axis represents various configurations, while the vertical axis shows the accuracy percentage. The configurations are labeled as "Ours," "w/o comments," "w/o text," "w/o select," "w/o emotion," and "w/o cognition." The accuracy percentages range from approximately 80.1% to 90.57%. The "Ours" configuration has the highest accuracy at 89.84%, followed by "w/o emotion" at 88.80%, and "w/o cognition" at 87.74%. The lowest accuracy is observed in the "w/o text" configuration at 80.1%. The bars are color-coded, with "Ours" in red, "w/o comments" in orange, "w/o text" in light blue, "w/o select" in dark blue, "w/o emotion" in yellow, and "w/o cognition" in green. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on any of the bars.
